purpose: Review four existing JVM/runtime/configuration topics as eight Korean/English manuscripts with executable examples.

newEnglishEditions.policy: Refresh the first English publishedAt/updatedAt timestamps only after explicit approval. Preserve Korean original dates and all reviewed bodies.

selectionEvidence.source: Search Console API, actual-search-status-2026-10-27.json stored outside the repository
selectionEvidence.period: 2026-09-29 through 2026-10-26 America/Los_Angeles, dataState all; October25 onward provisional
selectionEvidence.limits: Small historical sample; no claim of established demand for the new English editions.

sourceVerification.temurinInitialReleasePublishedAt: 2023-10-10T13:55:52Z from the official GitHub release metadata; not all asset upload times

liveAdoptiumMetadata.limits: Volatile lookup; neither production-version recommendation nor binary integrity verification.

sourceVerification.openjdkDirectFetch: OpenJDK project/JEP pages returned403; use Oracle Java21 API/language/release documentation instead.

review.type: Two-pass self AI review: technical/semantic comparison, then independent reading of each language edition.
review.scope: Eight titles/descriptions/bodies, paired code, primary-source dates, source identity, code checker scope and public reader output.

findings.issue: Original Batch article exposed destructive column changes without completed value migration.
findings.resolution: Remove generic executable migration SQL; require DB-specific rehearsal and document v4 history/restart restrictions. Fresh-schema tests are explicitly not data migration proof.

findings.issue: Original YAML example accepted numeric-looking YAML strings after rendering.
findings.resolution: Use typed safe_load plus exact int/range checks; reject booleans and strings; test parser and command boundary.

findings.issue: Original Temurin text dated the notice update October10.
findings.resolution: Use October9 notice update and distinguish October10 GitHub publication.

findings.issue: Separate shell lines could run selector after failed curl.
Non-string package URL could trigger an uncaught parsing exception.
findings.resolution: Reject non-string URL and cover it in fixtures.

findings.issue: YAML serializer emitted unquoted reviewedAt, interpreted as Date by Astro.
findings.resolution: Quote all eight dates; rerun schema/build tests.

checks: failed instance new execution skips completed Step
limits: one process, no JVM restart or exactly-once external side-effect proof

siteValidation.eightPageAudit: Passed canonical, reciprocal en/ko and x-default, H1/descriptions/OG/schema dates, RSS, search indexes, sitemap lastmod, reader code and absence of editorial banners.

ci: Both executable checkers configured. Final PR check result tracked separately.
publication: Draft review only. No batch changes deployed before explicit approval.
